Some places feel unreal. Positano is one of them.

Cliffside houses glowing in the sun, narrow streets leading down to the sea, and that easy Mediterranean pace that makes you forget what time it is.

Positano is a breathtaking, cliffside village on Italy's Amalfi Coast.

Famous for its pastel-colored houses, dramatic vertical layout, and stunning Mediterranean views, it features steep cobblestone streets, chic boutiques, and world-class seaside dining. It is easily reached via a ferry or taxi from nearby Naples or Sorrento.

reels.caption:
Tulum, Mexico looks like a ghost town in 2026, after the Americans who fell in love with it, left. Here's everything that went wrong.

Tulum represented the fantasy of a lifestyle so many Americans were craving: something simpler, healthier, and more connected. And at the same time luxurious, comfortable and affordable.

Americans and other foreigners came en masse to live that dream here in Tulum as remote work went mainstream because of the pandemic.

Locals and foreign investors built out the infrastructure to support that dream. They became entrepreneurs opening restaurants, hotels, and beach clubs. They developed condos, and houses. All aesthetically optimized for Instagram.

At the same time, many locals as well as foreign investors got a taste of something they may not have experienced before: money, a lot of it.

One local, who declined to be interviewed, told me Tulum was a gold rush. But the monetization of Tulum went a little too far.

Costs went through the roof and scams proliferated, but quality of life was getting worse in some key respects.

And it became cool to hate Tulum.

#tulummexico #tulumvibes #americansabroad #expatexit #mexicoexpats
